name: Sports Odds API (BetRivers, Unibet & 22 more books)
tagline: Live odds from 24 Kambi-powered sportsbooks in one call, with best price per outcome.
description:
Live odds from 24 Kambi-powered sportsbooks in one call — BetRivers (12 US states + Ontario), Unibet, Paf, Svenska Spel, ATG. One row per game with every book's price and the best price per outcome. Pay per call, no subscription.

Streamable HTTP endpoint hosted by Apify. Auth: Apify OAuth, or an Apify API token as a Bearer token.

- Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/sports-odds-api
- MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/sports-odds-api

Disclosure: I maintain this Actor.

env.name: APIFY_TOKEN
